concerns.text: The specification (FR‑019) requires validation of `evaluation_metrics.json` against `contracts/evaluation.schema.yaml`. No task in Phase 6 (or elsewhere) performs this schema‑validation step, leaving the evaluation output unverified.

The specification (FR‑034) mandates that the pipeline log conforms to `contracts/pipeline_log.schema.yaml`. There is no task that checks `pipeline.log` against this contract, so the logging requirement is not covered.
